title: Evidence Hound deployment config
description: One deployment: how to reach CISO Assistant, where evidence is stored, which collectors run and which audit they update. Secrets are references only.

url.description: CISO Assistant API address, for example http://localhost:8000/api/. HOUND_CA_URL overrides it.

root.description: Evidence folder, relative to the config file.

retention_days.description: Delete runs older than this; the latest successful run is always kept.

period_retention_years.description: Years each closed audit period's final run is kept, however old. Default 7.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the cron schedules are read in, for example Australia/Sydney. Default UTC.

jitter_seconds.description: Most seconds each collector's runs are delayed by, a stable amount per collector, so collectors sharing a schedule do not start together. 0 turns it off.

target.description: The one audit results are published to. Use 'targets' for several.

targets.description: Every audit results are published to. Each evidence file is uploaded once and linked from every audit that uses it.

scope.description: The compliance repo's scope folder (relative to this file). With it, a target that names an audit with a cycle publishes to the period open on the run's date, and each closed period's final run is kept.

secretReference.description: env:NAME for an environment variable or file:/absolute/path for a file such as a Docker secret. Never the secret itself.

type.description: A collector type this build knows, for example fake.

schedule.description: Five-field cron expression, read in scheduler.time_zone (UTC unless set).

settings.description: Plain, non-secret settings for the collector.

secrets.description: Secret references the collector resolves at run time.

mapping.description: Framework mapping file, relative to the config file.

compliance_assessment.description: The audit's ref_id in CISO Assistant.

controls.description: Control key to applied control ref_id in CISO Assistant.

health_control.description: ref_id of the applied control that each collector's health evidence is linked to, for example "Automated evidence collection".

no_evidence.description: What a row with no evidence goes to CISO Assistant as. Default non_compliant: CISO Assistant leaves not-assessed rows out of its compliance percentage, so they would read as compliant. not_assessed opts out.
